data.title: Wire design_md_additions surfacing into preplanning dispatch protocol

content.text: - dd-2: Preplanning orchestrator surfaces the payload for approval when non-null
- dd-4: On decline, skips write, tags design:tokens_pending, continues
- dd-5: In PREPLANNING_INTERACTIVE=false mode, emits INTERACTIVITY_DEFERRED

1. Edit plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/prompts/ui-designer-dispatch-protocol.md: insert Section 4b after Review Loop. Logic: check design_md_additions non-null → interactive: AskUserQuestion approve/decline → approve: invoke write-design-md-additions.sh → decline: tag design:tokens_pending → non-interactive: INTERACTIVITY_DEFERRED comment.
2. Edit plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md: reference new Section 4b in Phase H Step 7.
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Dispatch protocol references write-design-md-additions.sh — Verify: grep -q 'write-design-md-additions.sh' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/prompts/ui-designer-dispatch-protocol.md
- [ ] Handles decline with design:tokens_pending tag — Verify: grep -q 'design:tokens_pending' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/prompts/ui-designer-dispatch-protocol.md
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
